author: SinOfStrife
name: ServerManager
description: Browse all servers the bot belongs to in a paginated dashboard, inspect individual server statistics, and remotely leave servers.
install_msg: Thanks for installing ServerManager! Use `[p]slist` to browse servers or `[p]sinfo <guild_id>` to inspect a single server.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any personal or user data.
